title: Crash when baking VoxelGI in a specific project since 4.5.dev3
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.dev3, 4.5.dev5
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.dev2

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3 - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 570.153.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

The engine crashes when baking VoxelGI in a specific project since 4.5.dev3.

- Bake the VoxelGI node under the `A` node in the MRP below.

[voxelatten.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19641804/voxelatten.zip) (from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/80101#issuecomment-2785099688)
